definitions.explanation: A black or brownish-black solid fossil fuel used for heating and power generation.

examples.japanese: {石炭|せきたん}は{化石燃料|かせきねんりょう}の{一|ひと}つだ。
examples.english: Coal is one of the fossil fuels.

examples.japanese: {昔|むかし}は{石炭|せきたん}で{暖房|だんぼう}していた。
examples.english: In the old days, people heated with coal.

examples.japanese: {石炭|せきたん}{火力|かりょく}{発電|はつでん}は{環境|かんきょう}に{悪|わる}い。
examples.english: Coal-fired power generation is bad for the environment.

notes:
RELATED ENERGY/FUEL TERMS:
・{石油|せきゆ} (petroleum, oil)
・{天然|てんねん}ガス (natural gas)
・{化石燃料|かせきねんりょう} (fossil fuel)
・{再生可能|さいせいかのう}エネルギー (renewable energy)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{石炭|せきたん}を{掘|ほ}る (to mine coal)
・{石炭|せきたん}{産業|さんぎょう} (coal industry)
・{石炭|せきたん}{火力|かりょく}{発電所|はつでんしょ} (coal-fired power plant)
・{石炭|せきたん}{鉱山|こうざん} (coal mine)

HISTORICAL NOTE:
Coal mining was once a major industry in Japan, particularly in Kyushu and Hokkaido, but most mines have closed due to cheaper imports and environmental concerns.
